evidence.original_text: make sure to document all your explorations, even (or perhaps especially) those that led to dead ends. These comments will help you remember what you did and why. You can always remove these comments later if turning your notebook into a pipeline (see Rule 7) or preparing to share it with a wider audience (Rule 1), who may prefer to see a concise presentation of results rather than a detailed lab notebook.
